items.title: Chaos releases V-Ray 7.5 for 3ds Max with new AI features
items.excerpt: V-Ray 7 for 3ds Max Update 5 adds an experimental AI Assistant that answers technical questions, recommends stock assets and even rates renders out of ten for artistic merit; Veras, Anima and Vantage are updated too. Note: Chaos V-Ray Collection AI ran 11-07 (AEC Magazine) - this is the 3ds Max-specific release with the render-critique assistant.

history_match.title: Chaos brings AI deeper into V-Ray Collection

items.title: Chaos brings AI design exploration into Enscape
items.excerpt: Enscape 4.22 integrates Veras 2.0 directly into the real-time visualisation interface so architects can generate design variations, swap materials and moods, and use new AI video models without opening a separate window. Off-list domain (render category had no other fresh AI item); same Chaos family as the 11-07 V-Ray story.

history_match.title: Chaos brings AI deeper into V-Ray Collection

items.title: Speed Up Image Generation with FLUX 3 Image Klein on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs
items.excerpt: NVIDIA details TensorRT LLM VisualGen optimizations (NVFP4, fused kernels, torch.compile) for Black Forest Labs' FLUX 3 Image Klein, reporting up to 3.46x faster text-to-image and 4.45x faster image-to-image at 2048x2048 on a B200 - aimed at diffusion models inside design tools and image editors.

history_match.title: Welcome FLUX.3 Image Klein in Diffusers

items.title: In Conversation: Dylan Field and David Friedberg on the Human Role in Creating with AI
items.excerpt: Figma CEO Dylan Field and David Friedberg discuss why design is the new code, how to shape AI's creative output, and the human vision and judgment behind what gets made.

items.title: Agent Harness: Definition
items.excerpt: NN/g defines the agent harness - the software loop between an AI model and its tools - and explains how its context, permissions and limits shape what users can actually do with an agent.

history_match.title: The Role of UX in Agentic Software Factories

items.title: Otherwise you're just a machine
items.excerpt: AI is getting better at design; designers should too. A design hiring lead on the skills that separate strong designers now that anyone can turn an idea into a polished, vibe-coded prototype in minutes.

history_match.title: Even designers are now using AI to code Windows 11, and Microsoft says "we're only getting started"

items.title: Native is a floor, not a ceiling
items.excerpt: With AI, a polished look costs nothing; native system components bring what can't be drawn and move with the platform (e.g. Liquid Glass) one step ahead of what imitates it.

items.title: Berrypicking still beats the single answer for search, even in the world of AI
items.excerpt: Marcia Bates' 1989 berrypicking model explains what single-answer AI search still misses: people gather, shift and revise across sources - a design brief for AI search interfaces.

items.title: Build from award winning sites with Awwwards-mcp in Claude Code
items.excerpt: A walkthrough of adding an Awwwards MCP server to Claude Code, generating a cited design brief from award-winning reference sites and scoring your build against a reference. Community/tool-author post - check for self-promotion.

history_match.title: Building an AI-ready design system library: Code → Figma with MCP

items.title: Voice Chat with Agents
items.excerpt: Cursor adds realtime voice calls with agents on desktop, web and iOS: describe a change out loud, ask what an agent is doing and hear progress while the voice agent hands coding work to the chat agent ('Hey Siri, call Cursor').

items.title: Speed up design system documentation with the Figma agent
items.excerpt: Figma shows practical ways its agent speeds up documenting a design system. Note: related Figma blog on design systems + the agent was published earlier.

items.title: Tell Your Story with Seedance 2.5 | Adobe Firefly
items.excerpt: Adobe announces ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 video model is now available inside Firefly, free to try. Seedance 2.5 itself launched 10-23; the news is Firefly availability.

items.excerpt: The full AI filmmaking workflow behind 'Planet Hell': Seedance 2.5 on OpenArt driven over MCP by Claude Code and Codex, with Gemini as story editor. Cross-check with movies section.
